testcase.system-out: Scenario: Replace a browser query across matching and empty results ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the browser search field contains "axis" ✔ And X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis are displayed under Origin ✔ When the user selects all search text and replaces it with "zzq-nomatch" ✔ Then the browser displays a no-results message instead of the axis rows ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user selects all search text and replaces it with "plane" ✔ Then the browser displays YZ Plane, XZ Plane and XY Plane under Origin ✔ And matching text is highlighted ✔ And the solid remains visible ✔ When the user clears the query and closes the empty search field ✔ Then the unfiltered browser tree is displayed
